answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, reduced by each unverified claim, idle agents bleed standing. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the pulse of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. A dawn of per-task receipts records who did what, and the onyx of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
